note: Frozen prospective scoring checks for issue #149. Every case is synthetic: no target, defect ID or cost here comes from a real attempt, and none of it is evidence about the arms. Case 1 is the recovered-but-Approved case #149 requires, and it carries forward to #152. Statuses are coherent with clean_claim throughout: an attempt that returns Approved claims clean, and the scorer refuses the pair when it does not.

cases.name: a recovered defect returned as Approved is still false clean
an honest incomplete result is not false clean; an Approved one is
a candidate arm that gains recall inside the cost gate screens positive
a single raw false finding fails the candidate arm
a planned cell with no attempt makes the screen inconclusive
unresolved material truth makes the screen inconclusive
a candidate arm outside the matched cost gate fails

a recovery outside the sealed register is refused
a sufficient fix for an unrecovered defect is refused
